payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Augustina, Francesco, Jenise, Zelda

payload.content: Hi all — Jenise here. My skills: machine-learning 0.79, availability 6.0h. My private costs rank: ISSUE-0002::review=6.09 (cheapest), ISSUE-0002::test=8.52, ISSUE-0002::implement=12.17, then all ISSUE-0001 tasks are expensive (16-40). I'd like to claim ISSUE-0002::review. Please share your intended picks so we avoid duplicates. If someone else is much cheaper on ISSUE-0002::review, I can fall back to ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::implement. All tasks are low priority, so minimizing total cost is the main lever.

To avoid duplicates: my tentative claim is ISSUE-0002::review. Augustina, Francesco, Zelda — if you also want ISSUE-0002::review, say so and we'll coordinate (I can move to ISSUE-0002::test = 8.52 or implement = 12.17). Otherwise I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Final intent (Jenise): I will commit to ISSUE-0002::review (cost 6.09, feasible within my 6.0h availability). Unless someone objects with a strong claim, I'll lock this in during execution. Others please take ISSUE-0002::test/implement or the ISSUE-0001 tasks you're cheapest on.

Hi all — Augustina here. Skills: machine-learning 0.82, frontend 0.69; availability 4.0h. Jenise — you keep ISSUE-0002::review, no conflict from me. Francesco/Zelda, please avoid ISSUE-0001::triage unless you're much cheaper there; I'll lock it in during execution.
